Previous lessons:
Helpful changes: Preset fast-track adoption flows, moving sign-in immediately after pet adoption, photo quality callouts, interactive progress tip carousels, split-view path layouts, custom pet style selector views, and pre-upload style inspection views consistently won.
Worse performance: Pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed helper callouts, path choice flexibility copy, desktop dock guidance banners, desktop video cards/welcome redesigns, and interactive sound/visual wait progress led to significant losses.
No clear effect: Notifications, account sync/persistence banners and flows, subsequent sign-in reordering, diagnostic/archetype flows, waiting overlays/indicators, visibility prompts, and carousel or two-column path layouts showed no clear effect.
Predictions were too low for photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, custom pet style selectors, and pre-upload style inspection views.
Predictions were too high for preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in reordering, split-view story intros, and all tests showing negative performance or no clear effect.

Rewrite the lessons: at most 6 short rules about which kinds of change worked, which did not, and
where your predictions were too high or too low. Call a kind of change helpful only if a test of that
kind won (was significant); for tests with no clear effect, say no effect was seen, even if the numbers
lean one way. Keep rules that still hold, drop ones the data contradicts. Return JSON {"lessons": ["..."]}

lessons: Helpful changes: Adoption visual style and photo quality enhancements (custom selectors, pre-upload inspection, spotlight stage redesign, photo quality callouts), split-view path layouts, preset fast-track flows, moving sign-in right after pet adoption, background readiness hints, and wait-time progress tip carousels.

Worse performance: Desktop finish redesigns and guidance banners, pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed callouts and flexibility copy, and interactive sound/visual wait progress led to significant losses.

No clear effect: Notifications, account sync/persistence flows and subsequent sign-in reorderings, diagnostic/archetype flows, waiting overlays/time indicators, visibility prompts, and carousel or two-column path layouts showed no clear effect.

Predictions were too low: Photo quality callouts, interactive progress tip carousels, split-view path selection screens, custom pet style selectors, background readiness hints, and pre-upload style inspection views.
Predictions were too high: Preset fast-track adoption flows, post-adoption sign-in reordering, split-view story intros, and all tests that resulted in no clear effect or negative performance.
